_doc: DYEFIELD achievements (_spec/CONTRACT_STATS.md §S6.1): the single source of truth for the game (stats/achievements.ts attaches the detectors by slug) AND the portal seeder (forgeflow-games/pipeline/seed_dyefield_achievements.py). 29 rows, 340 XP: bronze 5 / silver 15 / gold 30. Fields are exactly the achievements table's (slug, name, description, tier, points, secret).
